# TDA Enterprise | BLove First

> TDA Enterprise provides professional environmental, health, and safety (EHS) services including OSHA training, safety audits, program development, and equipment inspections. BLove First (B Love Foundation, Inc.) is a faith-based nonprofit providing youth enrichment, occupational empowerment, and supportive services to transitioning youth and adults.

## TDA Enterprise (Business)

TDA Enterprise is a professional EHS consulting firm based in Nashville, Tennessee, serving businesses with 50-500 employees in manufacturing, construction, warehousing, and healthcare. Services include:

- OSHA 10-Hour and 30-Hour training and certification
- First Aid/CPR/AED training
- Safety audits and compliance assessments
- Equipment inspections (aerial work platforms, scaffolding, fall protection)
- Turnkey EHS program development
- Bilingual training and documentation support

## BLove First (Foundation)

BLove First is the operating name of B Love Foundation, Inc., a faith-based nonprofit organization providing community outreach, youth enrichment, occupational empowerment, and supportive services to under-represented citizens in transition.
